chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Ma'bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid that he told Al-Ridha (peace be upon him):

O son of the Messenger of God! The people narrate that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'Indeed God, the Mighty and Exalted, created Adam in His image?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'May God fight them! They have omitted the beginning part of the tradition. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) passed by two men who were verbally abusing each other. The Prophet (peace be upon him) heard one of them say to his companion, 'May God disfigure your face and of everyone who looks like you!' The Prophet of God (peace be upon him) said to him, 'O Abdullah! Do not say this to your brother, since indeed the Honorable, the Exalted God created Adam in His image.'

key_terms.أَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثِ: The beginning part of the tradition
key_terms.يَتَسَابَّانِ: They were verbally abusing each other

ai.seo_question: What is the context and meaning of the hadith that God created Adam in His image?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Prophet’s statement regarding Adam being created in God’s image was a contextual response to a specific insult ('May God disfigure your face'), thereby linking human physical beauty to the divine image rather than asserting literal anthropomorphism. This explanation serves to correct the common misconception of *tashbih* (likeness) by grounding the concept in the etymology of the insult, a nuance often missed in broader theological discussions. The hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on precise contextual interpretation (*siyaq*) to preserve the transcendence (*tanzih*) of God.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 11-12 Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja’far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Ma’bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid that he told Al-Ridha (s), “O son of the Prophet of God! The people narrate that the Messenger of God (s) said, ‘God created Adam in His image.’ The Imam (s) said, ‘May God kill them! They have omitted the beginning part of the tradition. The Messenger of God (s) passed by two men who were verbally abusing each other. The Prophet (s) heard one of them say to his companion, ‘May God disfigure your face and of everyone who looks like you!’ The Prophet of God (s) said, ‘O Abdullah! Do not say this to your brother since indeed the Honorable the Exalted God created Adam in His image.’”
